commands: echo "run=$GITHUB_RUN_ID attempt=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT actions=$GITHUB_ACTIONS"; git status --porcelain | head -20; echo "---rc=$?"

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1305/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}; gh pr diff 1305 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1305/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}/diff.patch | wc -l

for f in skills/review-and-fix/SKILL.md skills/review-and-fix/references/fixing.md skills/review-and-fix/references/loop-control.md; do printf '%s  ' "$f"; sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1; done
echo "--- contract entries ---"
grep -E 'review-and-fix/(SKILL|references/(fixing|loop-control))\.md' scripts/devflow-cloud-writer-contract.json

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
